The '''QuietLift 1400''' was a large [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] propulsion system that was used in the popular, two-person [[Yellow Demon 100 speeder bike]] produced by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]].<ref name="SWS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The QuietLift 1400 was first mentioned in ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', a [[1987]] supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]] and published by [[West End Games]].<ref name="SWS" />
